verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents that it is self-hosted, built to run entirely offline, and supports air-gapped deployment with local models via Ollama, so a user can keep chat data on their own infrastructure and away from model trainers. However, it never explicitly states a no-training policy or offers a training opt-out control. When connected to cloud OpenAI-compatible providers, whether data is used for training depends on that provider. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never used for training, a documented training opt-out or data-sharing control for cloud-provider connections, and independent corroboration.
